name: frontierplan
description: Astra-led research and planning with Luna (or Devin SWE-2) researchers, then axiom_for_herdr-style execution coordinated by Main with independent Sol review and Astra's one-time final check.

interface.shortDescription: Astra plans; Main coordinates execution and review.
interface.longDescription: Explicit-only AstraPlan-herdr, AstraPlan-herdr-swe2 and AstraPlan-subagent. Astra owns every judgment before implementation, using researchers and user questions relayed verbatim by Main. After the Plan starts, Main coordinates Workers and an independent Sol Reviewer in the axiom_for_herdr style, then asks Astra for one final check. Researchers and Workers are Codex Luna, or Devin CLI SWE-2 in the herdr-swe2 variant.
defaultPrompt: $frontierplan:astraplan-herdr でこの開発を進めてください。
$frontierplan:astraplan-herdr-swe2 でこの開発を進めてください。
$frontierplan:astraplan-subagent でこの開発を進めてください。
